summary.question: 金卡会员上个月的客单价和笔单价

payload.question: 金卡会员上个月的客单价和笔单价

metrics.label: 客单价
metrics.description: GMV ÷ 下单用户数（按人计算）。按订单计算的是“笔单价”。

answer.text: 上个月（2026年9月），金卡会员的客单价为 427.83 元（GMV 10.14 万元，下单用户数 237 人），笔单价为 335.75 元（GMV 10.14 万元，订单数 302 单）。

queries.title: 客单价、笔单价
queries.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 2) AS aov,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  AND c.member_level = '金卡会员'
LIMIT 1000
queries.executed_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 2) AS aov,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
) AS o
JOIN (
  SELECT
    age_band,
    city,
    customer_id,
    member_level,
    region_id,
    signup_date
  FROM customers
) AS c
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  AND c.member_level = '金卡会员'
LIMIT 1000
